content.json:
# Application Performance

Request rates, response times, failure rates, dependency health, and exception analysis from Application Insights.

content.query:
// Request volume, avg duration, failure rate tiles
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where AppRoleName in ({appName}) or '*' in ({appName})
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    AvgDuration_ms = avg(DurationMs),
    P95Duration_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95),
    FailureRate = round(100.0 * countif(Success == false) / count(), 2)
content.title: Key Application Metrics

content.query:
// Request rate & failure rate over time
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where AppRoleName in ({appName}) or '*' in ({appName})
| summarize Requests = count(), Failures = countif(Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend FailureRate = round(100.0 * Failures / Requests, 2)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Request Rate & Failure Rate (5m bins)

content.query:
// Response time percentiles over time
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where AppRoleName in ({appName}) or '*' in ({appName})
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
    P90 = percentile(DurationMs, 90),
    P99 = percentile(DurationMs, 99)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Response Time Percentiles (ms)

content.query:
// Slowest operations (avg > 1s)
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where AppRoleName in ({appName}) or '*' in ({appName})
| summarize AvgDuration = avg(DurationMs), Count = count() by Name
| where AvgDuration > 1000
| order by AvgDuration desc
| take 20
content.title: Slowest Operations (Avg > 1s)

content.query:
// Dependency health
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where AppRoleName in ({appName}) or '*' in ({appName})
| summarize
    Calls = count(),
    AvgDuration = avg(DurationMs),
    FailureRate = round(100.0 * countif(Success == false) / count(), 2)
  by Type, Target
| order by FailureRate desc
content.title: Dependency Health

content.query:
// Top exceptions
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where AppRoleName in ({appName}) or '*' in ({appName})
| summarize Count = count() by ExceptionType = tostring(split(ProblemId, ' at ')[0])
| order by Count desc
| take 15
content.title: Top Exceptions

content.query:
// Availability / SLI
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where AppRoleName in ({appName}) or '*' in ({appName})
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Successful = countif(Success == true)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| extend Availability = round(100.0 * Successful / Total, 3)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Hourly Availability (SLI)
